scope.purpose: Resolve semantic domains used by S8 parameter governance to governed owner roles where source evidence exists, while preserving unresolved owner hooks without invention.

entries.name: materials
entries.purpose: Material definitions, finishes, manufacturing specifications, and physical properties attached to model geometry.

entries.name: qaqc
entries.purpose: Quality assurance, compliance tracking, model validation flags, and review status parameters.

entries.name: avlc
entries.purpose: Audio, Video, Lighting, and Controls device identity, rack, and mounting parameters.

entries.name: asset
entries.purpose: Maintainable asset identity, lifecycle attributes, warranty, and facility-management operations data.

entries.name: export
entries.purpose: Cross-platform interoperability, IFC mapping, manufacturing exports, and external exchange schemas.

entries.name: core_governance
entries.purpose: Parameter standards, classification-system adoption, and master-registry change control.

entries.name: project_info
entries.purpose: Project context, identifiers, client references, phase, and baseline metadata across federated models.

entries.name: sheets
entries.purpose: Titleblock properties, drawing sheet numbering, issue dates, and revision tracking.

provenance.migration_note: Semantic domains are extracted from the shared-parameter governance workflow and reconciled to the governed Role Registry where exact or source-supported alias mappings exist. AVLC Lead and FM Lead remain unresolved.
